description:
Police-recorded offences in South Australia by suburb, per financial year (July to June) for 2015-16 to 2024-25, by offence type.

Coverage: South Australia: 1,582 suburbs; financial years 2015-16 to 2024-25. Current to 2025-06-30. Full description, field list and method: `/v1/datasets/recorded-crime-sa`.

**Price: 5¢ per call.**

fields.description: Comma-separated subset of: total_offences, abduction_harassment_and_other_offences, aggravated_robbery, assault_police, blackmail_and_extortion, common_assault, dangerous_or_negligent_acts, graffiti, murder, non_aggravated_robbery, obtain_benefit_by_deception, other_acts_intended_to_cause_injury, other_fraud_deception_and_related_offences, other_homicide_and_related_offences, other_offences_against_property, other_offences_against_the_person_nec, other_property_damage_and_environmental, other_theft, other_unlawful_entry_with_intent, property_damage_by_fire_or_explosion, receive_or_handle_proceeds_of_crime, serious_assault_not_resulting_in_injury, serious_assault_resulting_in_injury, serious_criminal_trespass_non_residence, serious_criminal_trespass_residence, theft_from_motor_vehicle, theft_from_shop, theft_or_illegal_use_of_a_motor_vehicle, threatening_behaviour. Omit for all.

suburb_name.description: Suburb name exactly as /v1/suburbs/list returns it, e.g. `Bondi` or `St Kilda (Vic.)`.

to.description: Last period to include, same formats as `from`.

name: suburbs_crime_recorded_offences_sa
